## Fish Scale Analysis

Load the tidyverse and the dataset.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
fish_data <- read_csv("../data_raw/Gaeta_etal_CLC_data.csv")
```

Observe the dataset.

```{r}
# shows the first six rows of fish_data
head(fish_data)
```

Summary statistics for fish scale length.

```{r}
# summarizes the data by creating new columns with the minimum, maximum, and mean scale length 
fish_data |> 
  summarize(min_scale_length=min(scalelength, na.rm=T), 
            max_scale_length=max(scalelength, na.rm=T), 
            mean_scale_length=mean(scalelength, na.rm=T))
```

## 3. Committing multiple files 

```{r}
fish_data_clean <- fish_data |> 
  filter(scalelength>1)
fish_data_clean
write_csv(fish_data_clean, "../data_clean/fish_data_clean.csv")
```

```{r}
ggplot(fish_data, aes(x = scalelength)) +
  geom_histogram()
```
